notes: 1 section header — too few for a contents list.

decisions.label: Rebuild the heading outline
decisions.why: 1 heading sits at a level the page never opens — "Process for Obtaining Authorization or Exemption" is an h3 with no h2 above it, so it is neither announced nor styled as the sub-section it is. Each heading moves to one level below whatever encloses it.

decisions.label: Turn the headings into section headers
decisions.why: 1 heading is plain text where every other page uses a section header, so the page reads as one continuous wall instead of parts.

decisions.label: Separate a link from its description
decisions.why: 1 list item opens with a link and then explain it, all at the same weight — so the thing you can click is no easier to find than the sentence about it. The link becomes the item and the explanation sits under it.

decisions.label: Set a job title the way the rest of the site does
decisions.why: 1 job title sits in plain text under the person's name, where 186 elsewhere on the site are in italics — so the same contact block is drawn two ways depending on the page, and the title runs into the name above it. The standard here is the site's own, not a preference: two thirds of these blocks already do it. No word changes.
